rationale: The entry sensor worked for a year and failed immediately after being dropped on tiles during a battery change. It remains offline even placed next to the base station after a reset, despite strong RSSI (-60 dBm), adequate battery (75%), compatible firmware (v3), and no error codes — while all other devices on the same base station are online. This pattern points to physical damage to the radio module or internal circuitry from the impact, requiring FAE evaluation/replacement.

output.symptom_summary: Entry motion sensor (SEN-M1) went offline immediately after being dropped on tiles during a battery change and remains offline even when placed next to the base station after a reset, while all other devices on the same base station are online.
